articleBody:
- [ ] Exact room measurements — Having precise wall lengths, ceiling heights, and window openings prevents ordering cabinets that crowd doorways.
- [ ] Fixed utility map — Noting current plumbing, gas lines, and electrical outlets helps you decide whether keeping existing locations will save on trade costs.
- [ ] Appliance specification sheets — Gathering exact exterior dimensions and door clearance requirements ensures chosen appliances fit compact cutouts.
- [ ] Clear circulation check — Confirming at least 36 inches of walking space between opposite counters keeps the work area functional and safe.
- [ ] Vertical storage plan — Planning upper cabinets that extend toward the ceiling maximizes storage capacity without stealing counter workspace.
- [ ] Door and drawer swing clearances — Verifying that open oven, dishwasher, and cabinet doors will not collide prevents daily bottlenecks.
- [ ] Written project scope — Creating an itemized list of desired materials and finishes ensures contractors give you accurate, comparable estimates.
- [ ] Proof of contractor credentials — Requesting verification of insurance, bonding, and workers' compensation coverage ensures your home is protected during construction.

How to use this checklist:
Review these concrete items before scheduling site estimates for your compact kitchen renovation. Having these dimensions and priorities organized streamlines your consultation and ensures clear bids.
